# pai hooks-db

Registry updates for the stop and pre-compact hooks

```
pai hooks-db <command>
```

Called by the shell hooks, not by hand. Marks the latest session of a project completed (session-stop) or compacted (pre-compact). Always exits 0 so a hook can never block a session.

```sh
pai hooks-db session-stop my-project
pai hooks-db pre-compact my-project
```

See also: `pai session handover`

### pai hooks-db session-stop

Mark the project's latest session completed

```
pai hooks-db session-stop PROJECT_SLUG
```

Used by the stop hook. Exits 0 whatever happens.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PROJECT_SLUG` | yes | Project slug |

```sh
pai hooks-db session-stop my-project
pai hooks-db session-stop "$PROJECT_SLUG"
```

### pai hooks-db pre-compact

Mark the project's open session compacted and log it

```
pai hooks-db pre-compact PROJECT_SLUG
```

Used by the pre-compact hook. Exits 0 whatever happens.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PROJECT_SLUG` | yes | Project slug |

```sh
pai hooks-db pre-compact my-project
pai hooks-db pre-compact "$PROJECT_SLUG"
```

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `pai hooks-db session-stop` | Mark the project's latest session completed |
| `pai hooks-db pre-compact` | Mark the project's open session compacted and log it |
